title: Jeremiah 45
paragraphs: ¹ The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when Baruch had written in a scroll the words that Jeremiah dictated — in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: ² "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch: ³ You said, 'Woe is me! The LORD has added sorrow to my grief. I am worn out with groaning and can find no rest.' ⁴ But tell him this: 'The LORD says — what I have built I am about to tear down, and what I have planted I am about to uproot — the whole land. ⁵ Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I am about to bring disaster on everyone, declares the LORD, but I will at least let you escape with your life wherever you go.'"
